meta.title: Legacy cross-source effect reconciliation
meta.scope: Differences visible in retained second-source audit snapshots, not fresh live item inspection
meta.warning: Historical audit reports compare earlier versions and are not automatically rewritten after corrections. Template placeholders are undecodable, not zero.

items.name: Heavy Armor Kit
currentEffect: Use: Permanently increase the Stamina value by 3 and armor value by 24 of an item worn on the chest, legs, hands or feet. Only usable on items level 15 and above.
items.notes: Recorded older tooltip contained unresolved zeros; client build 70862 resolves +3 Stamina/+24 armor, item level 15+.
sourceValues: Use: Permanently increase the Stamina value by 0c2 and armor value by 0c1 of an item worn on the chest, legs, hands or feet. Only usable on items level 0cim and above. (1 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Red Whelp Gloves
currentEffect: Equip: 5% chance of dealing 30 to 50 Fire damage on a successful melee attack.
items.notes: ForeverChanges marks this item Confirmed in game and displays 5% chance for 30–50 Fire damage in Forever build 70790. The older isolated 10% proc field is not the confirmed tooltip effect.
sourceValues: Equip: 5% chance of dealing 30 to 50 Fire damage on a successful melee attack.

items.name: Fletcher's Gloves
items.notes: Independent Forever client records give +14 Critical Strike and -15 Parry rating; the +14 Crit already exists in the raw tooltip's other lines. Avoid double-counting.
sourceValues: Equip: Increases your chance to Parry an attack by 1.0%.
Equip: Improves your chance to get a critical strike by 1.0%.

items.name: Green Whelp Armor
currentEffect: Equip: When struck by a melee attacker, that attacker has a 5% chance of being put to sleep for 10 sec. Only affects enemies level 50 and below.
items.notes: The extra '(Proc chance: 5%)' repeats the same value in the tooltip; removed only redundant metadata.
sourceValues: Equip: When struck by a melee attacker, that attacker has a 5% chance of being put to sleep for 10 sec.  Only affects enemies level 50 and below.

currentEffect: Equip: Increases your effective stealth level by 1.2.
items.notes: Client build 70790 and independent Forever pages agree +1.2 Stealth; older source build 70707 had +1.

items.name: Invulnerable Mail
currentEffect: Equip: When struck in combat has a 5% chance to make you invulnerable to melee damage for 3 sec. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec. (Proc chance: 5%, 10s cooldown)
sourceValues: Equip: When struck in combat has a 5% chance to make you invulnerable to melee damage for 3 sec. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec sec.
